desc_id: Warga Dusun Klipoh, sekitar tiga kilometer dari Candi Borobudur, membuat kendil, cobek, dan kuali dari tanah liat. Tanah liat dibentuk, lalu dibakar agar keras. Keahlian ini diwariskan turun-temurun.
desc_en: The people of Klipoh Hamlet, about three kilometres from Borobudur Temple, make cooking pots, grinding bowls and woks from clay. The clay is shaped, then fired to make it hard. This skill is passed down from parents to children.
